name: Kasanashi-san
source:
Kasanashi-san is the spirit of a man who threw himself off a bridge.
Kasanashi-san really hates this world.
I, too, hate this world.

A short story about a bullied boy and a ghost who met on a rainy day, and the week following it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23571]Freem![/url]]
translation:
Kasanashi先生是一个投桥自尽的男人留下的亡灵。
Kasanashi先生非常讨厌这个世界。
我也讨厌这个世界。

一篇讲述受欺凌的男孩与幽灵的短篇故事。两人在一个雨天相遇，故事由此展开，持续了一周。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23571]Freem![/url]]
